# BrownHub

## Overview
BrownHub is a creative graphic design company in Accra, Ghana, helping businesses, brands, entrepreneurs and individuals communicate their ideas through compelling visual design.

## Services
- Logo Design
- Brand Identity Design
- Social Media Design
- Flyer & Poster Design
- Business Card Design
- Brochure & Company Profile Design
- Packaging Design
- Marketing & Advertising Graphics
- Custom Graphic Design
- Website design and development

## What we do
Logos, brand identity systems, print and packaging — designed to make brands stand out, with websites and software as a secondary service.
